what: Hard cutover turns missing checks from fail-closed into success-equivalent skip
scenario_or_breakage: A consumer repo that still has the old .claude/skills/relevant-checks script or no migrated script gets RELEVANT_CHECKS_SKIPPED and /implement proceeds without pre-commit, agent-lint, or secret-scan coverage
suggested_fix: Use a transitional resolver: prefer scripts/relevant-checks.sh, fall back to the old script with a deprecation WARN token, and keep neither-present as STATUS=fail unless an explicit repo opt-out/config says checks are optional

what: Deleting the Skill-block hook removes the active-session backstop while stale consumer skills may still exist
scenario_or_breakage: During migration an orchestrator can accidentally Skill-invoke a consumer's old /relevant-checks, reintroducing unbounded transcripts and bypassing the captured/redacted helper contract
suggested_fix: Keep the hook for at least one release and update its deny reason to point at scripts/relevant-checks.sh; delete only after stale skill compatibility is intentionally dropped

what: The plan relies on docs and CHANGELOG for a required consumer-file migration
scenario_or_breakage: Existing consumers upgrade the plugin but do not add executable scripts/relevant-checks.sh, so the new helper silently skips local validation until someone notices the machine line
suggested_fix: Add a provisioning path: a setup/upgrade helper or SessionStart/session-setup advisory that detects old-path-only or missing scripts/relevant-checks.sh and gives/copies a template; make tests cover old-path-only migration behavior

what: The proposed final grep gate conflicts with historical changelog entries
scenario_or_breakage: The gate requiring no .claude/skills/relevant-checks or /relevant-checks references outside one migration note will fail on existing historical CHANGELOG entries or push contributors to rewrite history-style release notes
suggested_fix: Exclude CHANGELOG.md from the zero-reference grep and add a separate assertion that the new release section contains the migration note; leave historical entries intact
